description:
## Problem
`tests/unit/workflows/test_sqlglot_delivery_workflow.py::test_readiness_authenticates_without_repository_mutations[ready-Verified configured App authentication]` raises `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` when its `node -` child runs past the test's 20 s limit on `windows-latest`. sqlglot-delivery-readiness-windows-flake-20261120 was dropped as a single occurrence. It has since recurred:
- CI run 43887923771, 2026-11-16 (the occurrence recorded on the dropped item);
- #4410 at 7d8966ea57, 2026-11-20, rerun of run 44777675803 (recorded on feature-fix-corpus-classification-and-seed-provenance-20261120);
- #4331 at aa403069cc, 2026-11-22, run 45059651205.
Each time the PR under test did not touch the workflow or the test, `core` failed, and the merge needed an owner-authorised re-run.

## Change
Measure how long the `node -` child takes on `windows-latest` (cold and warm). Then either set the limit from that evidence or remove the cold-start cost from the measured path, keeping what the test asserts: readiness authenticates without mutating the repository.

## Decision gates
- The new limit, if any, is shown to the owner with the measured distribution before it is committed.
- Skipping or marking the test on Windows needs the owner's approval; it is not the default fix.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the child's duration on `windows-latest` is recorded from at least 20 runs (CI history or a dispatched loop); the limit is at least 3x the observed p99, or the cold start is gone from the measured path; and a deliberate repository mutation in the readiness path still makes the test fail.

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree from `make worktree-create`; never write in the primary clone. Stage named paths only; commit as the pinned human identity with no agent attribution.
- Push only after `make pr-preflight` passes on the exact head. Never `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite authorship.
- Arm only with `make pr-arm`, once per head. A second attempt only when the refusal named a cause that is now fixed; a third needs the owner. `make pr-rerun` only for a job the runner cancelled or never ran, never to re-roll a failed test.
- Never post a stand-in review. Resolve a review thread only after the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking target. Never set `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK` or `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off`.
- Any new limit, threshold, default or user-facing label is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- Do not mark a test skip, xfail, quarantine or slow to make it pass.
- Report only what merged and what was verified, with run ids and heads.
